died.name: George Murchison
died.cause: The 8-year-old boy from Aroostook County, Maine, died from a hemorrhage after having a live snake pulled out of his mouth. It was speculated the snake had entered his throat after he had "gone to sleep in some field".

born.name: Jim Jones
born.desc: American cult leader and mass murderer
born.cause: speaking to his followers, shortly after they had all been poisoned with cyanide. Jones died of a possibly self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head, while his followers died of cyanide poisoning
born.last_words: We didn't commit suicide, we committed an act of revolutionary suicide protesting the conditions of an inhumane world.
